environment: Windows, in-app browser, isolated loopback node, synthetic source-created branches

steps.action: Keep a deleted conversation's concurrent branch
steps.observed: Separate history opens with original recipient and readable messages; no model configured

steps.action: Delete that kept copy through the conversation page
steps.observed: Copy leaves ordinary history; original recovery remains
Explicit replacement review appears and receives focus; no automatic copy

steps.action: Tab twice and press Enter to cancel
steps.observed: Review closes; focus returns to the original branch button

steps.action: Reopen review, Tab and Enter to confirm
steps.observed: A different conversation identity opens with original recipient and messages

steps.action: Stop the node process, restart with its original data directory, reload
steps.observed: Replacement history remains readable without a model

steps.action: Repeat the original branch and replacement confirmation
steps.observed: The same replacement identity opens; only one such copy remains in the visible history

limits: Not packaged desktop or physical-device/cross-NAT acceptance

Response-loss retry and write failure were automated checks, not browser-injected failures

cleanup: Temporary browser tab closed and node process stopped; isolated data directory retained
